workload.title: Team workload
workload.capacityLine: The dashed line marks capacity for the next 2 weeks ({{count}} points).
workload.capacityLineMixed: The dashed line marks each person’s capacity for the next 2 weeks.
workload.capTitle: Capacity for the next 2 weeks ≈ {{count}} points
workload.footnote: Size is the sum of story points on open tasks. The capacity marker is a rough per-person amount for the next 2 weeks ({{count}} points) — it is there to help share work fairly, not to rate anyone. Heavy / Balanced / Light compare it with what is overdue, due in the next 2 weeks or in a current sprint; the rest is outlined as “Not due soon”.
workload.footnoteMixed: Size is the sum of story points on open tasks. The capacity marker is a rough per-person amount for the next 2 weeks — it is there to help share work fairly, not to rate anyone. Heavy / Balanced / Light compare it with what is overdue, due in the next 2 weeks or in a current sprint; the rest is outlined as “Not due soon”.
